outcome: Modified respiratory distress assessment instrument (RDAI) score
cohort: 70 children aged 1-24 months admitted to the hospital with bronchiolitis.
finding: Nebulized 3% hypertonic saline is more effective than nebulized levosalbutamol in reducing clinical severity and hospital stay in children with bronchiolitis.
birth_weight: Not specified, but the mean birth weight of the two groups are provided
